newsitem.title: USA: Health Management completes stock deal.
newsitem.headline: Health Management completes stock deal.

text.p: Health Management Inc said it completed a stock purchase agreement with Transworld Home Healthcare Inc and modified the terms of a separate but related merger agreement.

Transworld purchased 8.9 million newly issued Health Management common shares at $1.00 per share. The shares constitute 49 percent of the outstanding shares of Health Management, said the pharmacy management services firm.

Transworld, an alternate site healthcare services provider, also received an option to purchase an additional 746,713 shares, and upon exercise of such option, would hold 51 percent of Health Management's outstanding shares, it said.

Separately, the company said a merger agreement in which a new subsidiary of Transworld would merge into HMI was amended. "The original merger agreement provided for HMI stockholders to receive $2.00 per share in cash. Under the amended agreement, the consideration has been reduced to $1.50 per share and Transworld's financing contingency has been extended to the date of the merger," Health Management said.
"The amendment followed an assessment by Transworld of HMI's recent business performance. The other terms of the transaction remain substantially unchanged," the firm said.
